description: This file contains functions and types for fetching and processing usage data from the Codex API, including handling rate limits, reset times, and plan information.

methods.name: resolveSecondaryWindowLabel
methods.description: Determines the label ('Week', 'Day', or hours) for the secondary usage window based on window hours and reset timestamps.

methods.name: fetchCodexUsage
methods.description: Fetches usage data from the Codex API, processes rate limits, resets, and plan info, and returns a snapshot object.
